My name is what it is, and I am farming this small maize plot here near Mzuzu. The plot is only 0.05 hectares, so I can manage it mostly with my own hands, but maize needs fertilizer here or the yields will be very poor — I will buy a small bag of Urea and some NPK if the AIP coupon comes through, and I also carry manure from the goats to mix in. I plant hybrid seed because the local seed does not give enough cobs, and I intercrop with beans and pumpkins the way my mother taught me. I cannot afford to irrigate or hire much labor, so I rely on the rains and on myself, with maybe a few days of help from a neighbor at weeding time.
